Aldwyn Labs · Website design study

The brief

A clear starting point.

Create a website for Aldwyn Labs that makes the offer easy to understand: business websites, with optional website care. Give the studio a clear visual voice and a dedicated place to share projects as they develop.

The thinking

Every detail has a job.

A few choices shaping this project.

An identity that holds together.

The chosen interlocking AL monogram stays consistent across the site. Dark aubergine and plum provide the foundation; iris is reserved for emphasis, selected artwork and important actions.

A page for each useful question.

Services explain the website offer. Website Care describes the boundaries of ongoing support. The Studio introduces the approach, while the Portfolio gives individual projects space for their story.

A quieter way to show the work.

Project status and context are visible beside the design. This entry documents the studio’s own website while it is being developed, including the choices that guide its structure and visual direction.

In development

What’s taking shape.

  • A shared visual system across the main website pages
  • A portfolio with individual project stories
  • Layouts designed to adapt to desktop and mobile
  • A local brief-preparation tool for the project-start page

Current status

The multi-page website is being developed and reviewed. Typography and interface details remain open to refinement. The site is not published, and the brief tool does not send an enquiry.
